authority: existing SQLiteExecutionRepository checkpoint and accepted engine execution; no additional database or provider owner
identity: canonical content-only provider ID, model ID, exact validated loaded artifact receipt and local inference default seed, with a SHA-256 binding digest; no artifact paths, credentials or caller assertions
admission: commit the complete existing initial execution payload plus local artifact binding before first local model dispatch
recovery: unfinished execution requires exact original artifact descriptor, inference seed and valid binding digest before any resumed dispatch; changed weights under the same model/provider names, changed local inference seed, descriptor corruption and local-to-hosted substitution fail closed
compatibility: completed executions replay their existing result without loading or comparing a new provider; hosted executions retain existing behavior; only an exact pristine CREATED initial checkpoint may acquire a missing local pin, otherwise unfinished legacy local checkpoints fail closed
accounting: binding failures preserve already committed provider/tool receipts and actual usage when the canonical checkpoint remains readable
failure: durable explicit local_provider_binding_missing or local_provider_binding_mismatch terminal failure before another provider dispatch
scope_limitations: no serving migration, source-rights propagation, new provider grant or production promotion
